The examples are candidate patterns, independent of a verified fraud finding or automatic action.

contributions.original_prompts:
New raw `raw/stripe-radar-analytics-fraud-insights-2026-11-07.md`. Prior raw `raw/stripe-radar-fraud-insights-2026.md`. Current summaries `wiki/sources/source-stripe-radar-fraud-insights.md`.

- Q1. For `https://docs.stripe.com/radar/analytics/fraud-insights`, what documented behavior, prerequisites, actors and state transitions does the complete new capture establish? How do these compare with the matched prior capture and each mapped summary?

- Q2. Which changes are substantive, presentational or navigation-only? Identify the exact dated qualifications, conflicts and reciprocal routes that the proposed disposition should preserve.

reviewed_answers.Q1: At https://docs.stripe.com/radar/analytics/fraud-insights, November names Radar Plus for the Dashboard Insights tab. The operator sees near-real-time prior three months by default, initially filtered to risk scores greater than 65, more than 10 charges per card number per hour and a successful-payment status filter. The merchant can adjust ranges, status and attributes, view pivoted metrics, and drill into transactions for decisions (old raw lines 15-87; new raw lines 17-89). November also documents Radar analysis of payments that triggered an alert, possible patterns per alert, underlying payments and metrics, and discretionary custom rule or risk settings responses (new raw lines 91-108). source-stripe-radar-fraud-insights.md reflects May's Radar for Fraud Teams view and needs the dated alert feature and plan language. Neither a detected pattern nor a view change establishes an automatic refund, control change, or verified fraud.
reviewed_answers.Q2: For https://docs.stripe.com/radar/analytics/fraud-insights, naming Radar Plus in November instead of May's Radar for Fraud Teams and adding an alert-triggered agentic insights workflow are substantive documentation changes (old raw lines 8-13 and old raw lines 76-87; new raw lines 9-15 and new raw lines 91-108). The changed table separators and wording leave filters and outputs intact. Preserve the May 10 names and precise initial UI thresholds in source-stripe-radar-fraud-insights.md. Read the November plan table separately, which distinguishes broad fraud-alert support from agentic insights on Plus and Pro. Keep the reciprocal Radar concept, fraud alerts, analytics, settings and rules routes. An alert is a trigger for analysis, while the operator decides whether to refund or adjust controls.
